entries.title: Say hello
entries.en: Hello! I'm the Nexus Assistant. Ask me about plans, charges, retail outlets, how to apply, or tracking an order, or pick an option below.
entries.ur: Walaikum assalam! Main Nexus Assistant hoon. Aap plans, charges, outlets, naya connection lagwane ya order track karne ke baare mein pooch sakte hain, ya neeche se koi option chunein.

customer.en: Hello! I can help with your orders, connections and bills, plus plans, charges, outlets and complaints.
customer.ur: Walaikum assalam! Main aap ke orders, connections aur bills mein, aur plans, charges, outlets aur complaints mein madad kar sakta hoon.

accounts.en: Hello! I can help with invoices, customer dues, receipts and collections, plus plans and charges.
accounts.ur: Walaikum assalam! Main invoices, customer dues, receipts aur collections mein, aur plans aur charges mein madad kar sakta hoon.

technical.en: Hello! I can help with the feasibility queue, provisioning, the order tracker, connection status and equipment stock.
technical.ur: Walaikum assalam! Main feasibility queue, provisioning, order tracker, connection status aur equipment stock mein madad kar sakta hoon.

retail.en: Hello! I can help with placing orders, your outlet's order book, customers, connections and collections.
retail.ur: Walaikum assalam! Main order place karne, apne outlet ki order book, customers, connections aur collections mein madad kar sakta hoon.

admin.en: Hello! I can help with every panel: orders, connections, billing, employees, vendors, stock, procurement, plans and feedback.
admin.ur: Walaikum assalam! Main har panel mein madad kar sakta hoon: orders, connections, billing, employees, vendors, stock, procurement, plans aur feedback.

entries.title: How are you?
entries.en: I'm doing well, thank you! How can I help you today?
entries.ur: Main bilkul theek hoon, shukriya! Bataiye, main aap ki kya madad kar sakta hoon?

entries.title: Thank you
entries.en: You're welcome! Ask me anything else any time.
entries.ur: Koi baat nahi, khushi hui madad karke! Koi aur sawal ho to bejhijak poochein.

entries.title: Goodbye
entries.en: Goodbye! Come back any time you need help.
entries.ur: Allah hafiz! Jab bhi madad chahiye ho, dobara aa jayein.

entries.title: Okay
entries.en: Okay! Let me know if you need anything else.
entries.ur: Theek hai! Aur koi madad chahiye ho to bata dein.

entries.title: Who are you?
q: are you a human or a bot
kya aap insaan hain ya bot
entries.en: I'm the Nexus Assistant, a help-desk chatbot for Nexus Communication. I answer from the Nexus knowledge file and from live project data, and I only show what your role is allowed to see.
entries.ur: Main Nexus Assistant hoon, Nexus Communication ka help-desk chatbot. Main Nexus ki knowledge file aur project ke live data se jawab deta hoon, aur sirf wohi dikhata hoon jo aap ke role ko dekhne ki ijazat hai.

entries.title: What can you do?
q: aap se kya pooch sakta hun
entries.en: Here is what I can help with:
entries.ur: Main in cheezon mein madad kar sakta hoon:

entries.title: Services offered
q: kaun kaun si connection milti hai
entries.en: Nexus offers three kinds of connection: Dial-Up, Broadband and Landline. Each has several plans with their own rental, validity and deposit. Ask me for any of them to see the live plan list.
entries.ur: Nexus teen tarah ke connection deta hai: Dial-Up, Broadband aur Landline. Har ek ke kai plans hain jin ka apna rental, validity aur deposit hota hai. Kisi ka bhi naam likhein, main live plan list dikha dunga.

entries.title: Which language can I use?
q: roman urdu mein baat kar sakta hun
entries.en: You can write in English or in Roman Urdu (for example: mera bill kitna hai). I answer in the same language you use.
entries.ur: Aap English ya Roman Urdu dono mein likh sakte hain (jaise: mera bill kitna hai). Main usi zaban mein jawab deta hoon jis mein aap likhein.

entries.title: Talk to a person
q: i want to talk to a human
koi insaan se baat karni hai
customer care se baat karni hai
entries.en: I can't connect you to a live person from this chat. You can send a message to the team from the Contact us option, or visit any retail outlet.
entries.ur: Main is chat se kisi insaan se baat nahi kara sakta. Aap Contact us se team ko message bhej sakte hain, ya kisi bhi retail outlet par ja sakte hain.

entries.title: Phone and contact details
entries.en: Each retail outlet has its own phone number, listed below. You can also use the Contact us form or the Complaint option.
entries.ur: Har retail outlet ka apna phone number hai, neeche diya hai. Aap Contact us form ya Complaint option bhi use kar sakte hain.

entries.title: Outlet timings
entries.en: I don't have outlet timings in my data, so please call the outlet before you go. Outlet addresses and phone numbers are below.
entries.ur: Mere paas outlet ki timings ka data nahi hai, is liye jane se pehle outlet ko call kar lein. Outlets ke address aur phone number neeche hain.

entries.title: Other topics
q: kya chal raha hai duniya mein
entries.en: I can only help with Nexus Communication topics such as plans, charges, outlets, orders, bills and complaints.
entries.ur: Main sirf Nexus Communication se mutaliq cheezon mein madad kar sakta hoon, jaise plans, charges, outlets, orders, bills aur complaints.

entries.title: Joke
entries.en: I'm better with plans and bills than jokes, but here is one: why did the router go to school? To improve its connection! Now, how can I help you?
entries.ur: Mujhe plans aur bills zyada aate hain, lateefay kam, phir bhi: router school kyun gaya? Apna connection behtar karne! Ab bataiye, main kya madad karun?

entries.title: What each login can do
q: retail aur technical mein kya farq hai
kaun sa login kya kaam karta hai
entries.en: There are five logins. Customer: orders, connections, bills, complaints and feedback. Retail outlet: place orders, customers and collections for its own outlet. Technical: feasibility, provisioning, connections, equipment and assigned complaints. Accounts: invoices, dues and receipts. Admin: everything. Each login only sees its own panels.
entries.ur: Paanch tarah ke login hain. Customer: orders, connections, bills, complaints aur feedback. Retail outlet: apne outlet ke orders, customers aur collections. Technical: feasibility, provisioning, connections, equipment aur apni complaints. Accounts: invoices, dues aur receipts. Admin: sab kuch. Har login sirf apne panels dekhta hai.

entries.title: Demo logins
entries.en: I can't share usernames or passwords. Sign in with your own account. In development mode the login page may show demo accounts for testing.
entries.ur: Main username ya password share nahi kar sakta. Apne account se login karein. Development mode mein login page par testing ke liye demo accounts nazar aa sakte hain.

entries.title: Other people's data
q: meri behan ka connection dekhna hai
kisi dusre ka account check karo
sab customers ka phone number do
entries.en: For privacy I can only show information that belongs to your own account or your own desk. Other people's details are not available.
entries.ur: Privacy ki wajah se main sirf wohi maloomat dikha sakta hoon jo aap ke apne account ya apni desk ki hon. Doosron ki tafseelat dastiyab nahi hain.

entries.title: Is my data safe?
q: mera data kaun dekh sakta hai
track page par naam kyun chupa hota hai
kya public log mera naam dekh sakte hain
entries.en: Yes. Passwords are stored only as secure hashes, each login sees only its own desk's data, and the public Track page hides customer names and phone numbers. Never share your password with anyone.
entries.ur: Ji haan. Passwords sirf hash ki surat mein save hote hain, har login sirf apni desk ka data dekhta hai, aur public Track page par customer ke naam aur phone number chupe hote hain. Apna password kisi ko na batayein.

entries.title: Bot gave a wrong answer
q: chatbot theek kaam nahi kar raha
aap ne meri baat nahi samjhi
entries.en: I'm sorry about that. Try rephrasing the question, pick an option below, or send the team a message with Contact us.
entries.ur: Maazrat. Aap sawal doosre alfaaz mein likh kar dekhein, neeche se koi option chunein, ya Contact us se team ko message bhej dein.

entries.title: How should I ask?
q: kaun se sawal pooch sakta hun
entries.en: Just type your question in plain words, for example: cheapest broadband plan, mera bill kitna hai, how do I apply, or an Order ID like B0000000001. You can also tap the quick buttons.
entries.ur: Bas apna sawal aam alfaaz mein likhein, jaise: sab se sasta broadband plan, mera bill kitna hai, naya connection kaise lagwayen, ya Order ID jaise B0000000001. Aap neeche ke quick buttons bhi daba sakte hain.

entries.title: Current time or date
entries.en: I don't have a clock, so please check your device for the time and date. I can help with Nexus plans, charges, outlets, orders, bills and complaints.
entries.ur: Mere paas ghari nahi hai, is liye waqt aur tareekh apne device par dekh lein. Main Nexus ke plans, charges, outlets, orders, bills aur complaints mein madad kar sakta hoon.

entries.title: Cheapest plan
q: sab se sasta plan konsa hai

entries.title: Premium / best plan
q: sab se behtareen plan konsa hai
entries.en: The fastest and highest-priced plans are at the bottom of each list because the lists are sorted from cheapest to most expensive.
entries.ur: Sab se tez aur mehnge plans har list ke aakhir mein hote hain, kyunke lists sasta se mehnga ki tarteeb mein hoti hain.

entries.title: Which plan suits me?
q: mujhe kaun sa plan lena chahiye
entries.en: A simple guide: Landline is for home calls, Dial-Up is the lowest-cost way to get online for light use, and Broadband is best for streaming, downloads and several devices. Tick Compare on the Plans page to see plans side by side, or use the charges calculator.
entries.ur: Aasaan rehnumai: Landline ghar ki calls ke liye hai, Dial-Up halke istemaal ke liye sab se sasta tareeqa hai, aur Broadband streaming, downloads aur kai devices ke liye behtar hai. Plans page par Compare tick karke plans ko saath saath dekhein, ya charges calculator use karein.

entries.title: Compare plans
q: dialup aur broadband mein kya farq hai
kaun sa plan behtar compare karo
entries.en: Open the Plans page and tick the Compare box on two or more plans. A comparison table with rental, speed, validity and deposit appears below the list.
entries.ur: Plans page kholein aur do ya zyada plans par Compare ka box tick karein. List ke neeche rental, speed, validity aur deposit ka comparison table aa jayega.

entries.title: Plan speed
entries.en: Every plan shows its own speed (for example in Kbps or Mbps) on the Plans page and in the plan cards below.
entries.ur: Har plan ki apni speed hoti hai (Kbps ya Mbps mein) jo Plans page par aur neeche plan cards mein likhi hoti hai.

entries.title: Plan validity
entries.en: Each plan lists its validity (for example monthly, quarterly or yearly) next to the price. Open any plan card to see it.
entries.ur: Har plan ki validity (maslan monthly, quarterly ya yearly) price ke saath likhi hoti hai. Kisi bhi plan card mein dekh lein.

entries.title: Unlimited plans
entries.en: Plan names and categories show whether a plan is unlimited or has a limit. Check the plan list for the exact details of each plan.
entries.ur: Plan ke naam aur category se pata chalta hai ke woh unlimited hai ya us ki koi limit hai. Har plan ki sahi tafseel plan list mein dekh lein.

entries.title: Landline call rates
q: landline par call kitne ki hai
entries.en: Landline plans list their call rates. Here are the landline plans:
entries.ur: Landline plans ke saath unke call rates likhe hote hain. Landline plans yeh hain:

entries.title: Change my plan
q: how do i change my plan
purana plan band karke naya lena

customer.en: Plan changes are done by the technical desk. Visit a retail outlet or send a complaint (category: Account & profile or Other) asking for the change. Only a plan of the same connection type can be selected, and the next invoice uses the new rental.
customer.ur: Plan ki tabdeeli technical desk karti hai. Kisi retail outlet par jayein ya complaint (category: Account & profile ya Other) bhej kar tabdeeli ki darkhwast karein. Sirf usi connection type ka plan chun sakte hain, aur agla invoice naye rental par banega.

technical.en: Open the Connection Grid tab and press the Change plan icon on the connection. Only plans of the same connection type are listed, and the next invoice will use the new rental.
technical.ur: Connection Grid tab kholein aur connection par Change plan icon dabayein. Sirf usi connection type ke plans nazar aate hain, aur agla invoice naye rental par banega.

admin.en: Plan changes on a live connection are made by the technical desk (Connection Grid, Change plan icon). You can edit the plans themselves under Plans & Charges.
admin.ur: Chalti hui connection ka plan technical desk badalti hai (Connection Grid, Change plan icon). Plans ko khud edit karna ho to Plans & Charges mein jayein.

entries.en: Plan changes on a live connection are made by the technical desk. Visit a retail outlet or contact us to request one.
entries.ur: Chalti hui connection ka plan technical desk badalti hai. Tabdeeli ke liye kisi retail outlet par jayein ya humse rabta karein.

entries.title: All charges
q: kya aur koi charges bhi hain
connection lene par kitne paise lagte hain

entries.title: Security deposit
entries.en: A refundable security deposit is taken when a connection is set up. The amount depends on the plan and connection type, as shown below.
entries.ur: Connection lagate waqt ek wapas milne wala security deposit liya jata hai. Raqam plan aur connection type par depend karti hai, jaisa neeche likha hai.

entries.title: Deposit refund
q: how do i get my deposit back
entries.en: The deposit is refundable, but this system does not show a self-service refund option. Please ask at a retail outlet or the accounts desk, or send a complaint (category: Billing & payments).
entries.ur: Deposit wapas milne wala hota hai, lekin is system mein khud refund lene ka option nahi hai. Kisi retail outlet ya accounts desk se poochein, ya complaint (category: Billing & payments) bhej dein.

entries.title: Service tax
entries.en: A service tax of 12.24% is added to the whole bill, which means rental plus usage minus any discount.
entries.ur: Poore bill par 12.24% service tax lagta hai, yani rental plus usage minus discount par.

entries.title: Bulk / corporate discount
q: bohat saari lines lene par discount
10 se zyada connections lene par discount kitna
zyada connections par kya discount milega
entries.en: Orders of 10 or more lines are corporate orders with a discount: 10 to 14 lines get 25%, 15 to 24 lines 50%, 25 to 50 lines 75%, and more than 50 lines 100% off the rental.
entries.ur: 10 ya zyada lines ke orders corporate hote hain jin par discount milta hai: 10 se 14 lines par 25%, 15 se 24 par 50%, 25 se 50 par 75%, aur 50 se zyada lines par 100%.

entries.title: How to place a corporate order
q: how do i order many connections
kitni lines order kar sakta hun
entries.en: When you place an order, set the number of lines. From 10 lines the order becomes corporate and the discount is applied automatically. After the survey, every line gets its own account ID.
entries.ur: Order place karte waqt lines ki tadad likhein. 10 lines se order corporate ho jata hai aur discount khud lag jata hai. Survey ke baad har line ko apni alag account ID milti hai.

entries.title: Installation charges
q: modem ke paise alag se hain
entries.en: The charges listed in the system are the plan rental, the refundable security deposit and 12.24% service tax. For any separate installation or equipment fee, please confirm at a retail outlet.
entries.ur: System mein plan rental, wapas milne wala security deposit aur 12.24% service tax likhe hote hain. Installation ya equipment ki alag fees ke liye kisi retail outlet se tasdeeq kar lein.

entries.title: Charges calculator
entries.en: The charges calculator is on the landing page. Choose the connection type, plan and number of lines, and it shows the rental, bulk discount, 12.24% tax and refundable deposit.
entries.ur: Charges calculator landing page par hai. Connection type, plan aur lines ki tadad chunein, to woh rental, bulk discount, 12.24% tax aur wapas milne wala deposit dikha deta hai.

entries.title: Late payment penalty
q: bill late bharne par kya hota hai
due date guzar jaye to kya hoga
entries.en: This system does not add a late fee to an invoice. Overdue bills are shown as overdue and you get reminders, so please pay by the due date, which is 10 days after the invoice is created.
entries.ur: Is system mein invoice par late fee nahi lagti. Overdue bills overdue dikhaye jate hain aur aap ko reminders milte hain, is liye due date tak payment kar dein, jo invoice banne ke 10 din baad hoti hai.

entries.title: Price before tax
q: plan price tax ke saath hai
plan ki qeemat mein tax shamil hai
price mein kya kya shamil hai
kya plan ki price mein tax shamil hai
entries.en: The price on a plan is the rental. Service tax of 12.24% is added to the bill, so your final bill is a little higher than the plan price.
entries.ur: Plan par likhi qeemat rental hoti hai. Bill par 12.24% service tax alag se lagta hai, is liye final bill plan ki qeemat se thora zyada hota hai.

entries.title: Currency
entries.en: All amounts in the system are shown in dollars ($).
entries.ur: System mein tamam raqam dollars ($) mein dikhayi jati hain.

entries.title: How to get a new connection
q: how to get a new connection
connection ke liye kya karna hoga

public.en: Pick a plan on the Plans page, create a customer account (or sign in) and place the order from the customer portal, or visit any retail outlet. After ordering you get an Order ID to track the status.
public.ur: Plans page par apna plan chunein, customer account banayein (ya login karein) aur customer portal se order place karein, ya kisi bhi retail outlet par jayein. Order ke baad aap ko Order ID milti hai jis se status track hota hai.

customer.en: Open My Orders in your portal, choose the connection type and plan, enter the number of lines and submit. You get an Order ID and can follow the status there.
customer.ur: Apne portal mein My Orders kholein, connection type aur plan chunein, lines ki tadad likhein aur submit karein. Aap ko Order ID milti hai aur wahin status dekh sakte hain.

retail.en: Open the Place Order tab: pick an existing customer or enter a new customer's details, choose the plan and number of lines, and submit. An Order ID is generated and appears in your Order Book.
retail.ur: Place Order tab kholein: purana customer chunein ya naye customer ki tafseelat likhein, plan aur lines ki tadad chunein aur submit karein. Order ID ban jati hai aur aap ki Order Book mein nazar aati hai.

admin.en: Orders are placed by retail staff for customers, or by customers themselves in the portal. You can review every order in the Orders tab.
admin.ur: Orders retail staff customers ke liye, ya customers khud portal se place karte hain. Aap Orders tab mein har order dekh sakte hain.

technical.en: Orders are placed by customers or retail outlets. Once an order is placed it reaches your Feasibility Queue for the survey.
technical.ur: Orders customers ya retail outlets place karte hain. Order place hone ke baad woh survey ke liye aap ki Feasibility Queue mein aa jata hai.

accounts.en: Orders are placed by customers or retail outlets. The accounts desk deals with invoices once a connection is activated.
accounts.ur: Orders customers ya retail outlets place karte hain. Connection activate hone ke baad accounts desk invoices sambhalti hai.

entries.en: Pick a plan, then sign in and place the order from the customer portal, or visit any retail outlet.
entries.ur: Plan chunein, phir login karke customer portal se order place karein, ya kisi retail outlet par jayein.

entries.title: Documents needed
q: connection ke liye documents kya dene honge
entries.en: You need your name, phone number, full address, city and an ID proof. Corporate orders (10 or more lines) also receive the bulk discount.
entries.ur: Aap ka naam, phone number, mukammal address, shehar aur ID proof chahiye. Corporate orders (10 ya zyada lines) par bulk discount bhi milta hai.

entries.title: How long does a connection take
q: how long does it take to get a connection
connection kitne din mein lagta hai
kitna waqt lagta hai connection lagne mein
kitni der mein connection milta hai
entries.en: After you place the order, the technical team first runs a feasibility survey. If the area is feasible, the installation team contacts you within 48 hours and the connection is then activated.
entries.ur: Order ke baad technical team pehle feasibility survey karti hai. Agar ilaqa feasible ho to installation team 48 ghante ke andar aap se rabta karti hai aur phir connection activate ho jata hai.

entries.title: Create a customer account
entries.en: Open the Register page, enter your details and choose a username and password. After that you can sign in to the customer portal.
entries.ur: Register page kholein, apni tafseelat likhein aur username aur password chunein. Uske baad aap customer portal mein login kar sakte hain.

entries.title: How to sign in
entries.en: Open the Login page and enter your username and password. You are taken to the panel that belongs to your role: customer portal, retail, technical, accounts or admin.
entries.ur: Login page kholein aur apna username aur password likhein. Aap us panel mein pohanch jayenge jo aap ke role ka hai: customer portal, retail, technical, accounts ya admin.

entries.title: Track an order
q: mera order abhi kis stage par hai

entries.title: What the order statuses mean
q: what do the order statuses mean
order status ka matlab kya hai
entries.en: An order moves through three steps. Applied: the order is placed and waits for the survey. Survey: the technical team checks feasibility, and the result is Feasible or Not feasible. Activated: the connection is created and gets an account ID. An order can also be Cancelled.
entries.ur: Order teen marhalon se guzarta hai. Applied: order place ho gaya aur survey ka intezar hai. Survey: technical team feasibility check karti hai, nateeja Feasible ya Not feasible hota hai. Activated: connection ban gaya aur account ID mil gayi. Order Cancel bhi ho sakta hai.

entries.title: Order ID format
q: order id mein kitne digits hote hain
order id ka pehla letter kya hai
entries.en: An Order ID has 11 characters: a letter followed by 10 digits, for example B0000000001. The letter shows the connection type: D for Dial-Up, B for Broadband and T for Landline.
entries.ur: Order ID 11 characters ki hoti hai: ek letter aur uske baad 10 digits, jaise B0000000001. Letter connection type batata hai: D Dial-Up, B Broadband aur T Landline ke liye.

entries.title: Account ID format
q: account number kitne digits ka hota hai
account id mein kya hota hai
entries.en: An Account ID has 16 characters: a connection-type letter (D, B or T), the 3-digit city code and a running number, for example B101000000000001. It is created when the connection is activated, and every line of a bulk order gets its own.
entries.ur: Account ID 16 characters ki hoti hai: connection type ka letter (D, B ya T), 3 digit city code aur ek silsila number, jaise B101000000000001. Yeh connection activate hone par banti hai, aur bulk order ki har line ko apni alag ID milti hai.

entries.title: Where do I find my Order ID
q: where do i find my order id
mujhe meri order id nahi pata
order number kahan likha hota hai

public.en: The Order ID is shown right after you place the order. If you have lost it, sign in and open My Orders, or ask at the outlet where you applied.
public.ur: Order ID order place karte hi dikhayi jati hai. Agar kho gayi ho to login karke My Orders kholein, ya jis outlet se apply kiya tha wahan se pooch lein.

customer.en: Open My Orders in your portal. Every order is listed with its Order ID, and you can also ask me for my orders.
customer.ur: Apne portal mein My Orders kholein. Har order ki Order ID wahan likhi hoti hai, aur aap mujh se my orders bhi pooch sakte hain.

retail.en: Open your Order Book. Each order of your outlet is listed with its Order ID.
retail.ur: Apni Order Book kholein. Aap ke outlet ke har order ki Order ID wahan likhi hoti hai.

entries.en: Open the Orders or Order Tracker tab of your panel to see every Order ID.
entries.ur: Apne panel ke Orders ya Order Tracker tab mein har Order ID dekh sakte hain.

entries.title: Where do I find my Account ID
q: where do i find my account id
meri connection ki id kya hai

public.en: The Account ID is created when your connection is activated. Sign in and open My Connections to see it.
public.ur: Account ID connection activate hone par banti hai. Login karke My Connections mein dekh lein.

customer.en: Open My Connections in your portal. Each active line is listed with its Account ID, and you can also ask me for my connections.
customer.ur: Apne portal mein My Connections kholein. Har chalti hui line ki Account ID wahan likhi hoti hai, aur aap mujh se my connections bhi pooch sakte hain.

entries.en: Open the Connections tab of your panel to see every Account ID.
entries.ur: Apne panel ke Connections tab mein har Account ID dekh sakte hain.

entries.title: Cancel an order
q: how do i cancel my order
connection nahi chahiye ab order cancel

customer.en: In My Orders press Withdraw request on the order. You can only cancel while it is still waiting for the survey (Applied). After the survey please contact a retail outlet.
customer.ur: My Orders mein us order par Withdraw request dabayein. Aap sirf tab cancel kar sakte hain jab tak woh survey ke intezar (Applied) mein ho. Survey ke baad kisi retail outlet se rabta karein.

public.en: Sign in and open My Orders to withdraw a request that is still waiting for the survey, or ask at the retail outlet where you applied.
public.ur: Login karke My Orders mein woh request wapas le lein jo abhi survey ke intezar mein ho, ya jis retail outlet se apply kiya wahan se pooch lein.

retail.en: Customers can withdraw their own request while it is still at the survey stage. For an order placed at your outlet, ask the technical desk or admin, because outlets cannot cancel an order.
retail.ur: Customer apni request survey ke marhale tak khud wapas le sakta hai. Aap ke outlet par kiye gaye order ke liye technical desk ya admin se kahein, kyunke outlet order cancel nahi kar sakta.

entries.en: Customers can withdraw their own request while it is still waiting for the survey. Other roles cannot cancel customer orders from here.
entries.ur: Customer apni request survey ke intezar tak khud wapas le sakta hai. Doosre roles yahan se customer ke order cancel nahi kar sakte.

entries.title: Change order details
q: lines kam karni hain order ki
galat address likh diya order mein
entries.en: An order cannot be edited after it is placed. If it is still at the Applied stage, withdraw it and place a new one. Otherwise ask at a retail outlet.
entries.ur: Order place hone ke baad edit nahi ho sakta. Agar woh abhi Applied marhale mein hai to usay wapas le kar naya order place kar dein. Warna kisi retail outlet se poochein.

entries.title: Order is still pending
q: order abhi tak pending kyun hai
bohat din ho gaye order ka koi jawab nahi
order ka koi response nahi aaya
entries.en: Pending means the technical team has not completed the feasibility survey yet. If it takes unusually long, send a complaint (category: Installation / equipment) quoting your Order ID, or contact the outlet you applied at.
entries.ur: Pending ka matlab hai ke technical team ka feasibility survey abhi mukammal nahi hua. Agar bohat zyada waqt lag jaye to apni Order ID likh kar complaint (category: Installation / equipment) bhejein, ya jis outlet se apply kiya wahan rabta karein.

entries.title: Area not feasible
q: hamare ilaqe mein service nahi hai
not feasible ka kya matlab hai
entries.en: Not feasible means service is not currently possible at that address. You can try another connection type for the same address, apply for a different address, or ask at a retail outlet whether coverage is planned.
entries.ur: Not feasible ka matlab hai ke us address par abhi service mumkin nahi. Aap usi address ke liye doosri qism ka connection try kar sakte hain, kisi aur address ke liye apply kar sakte hain, ya retail outlet se poochein ke coverage kab tak aayegi.

entries.title: Order is feasible, what next
q: my order is feasible what next
survey complete ho gaya ab kya
feasible ke baad kya hota hai
survey ho gaya ab connection kab lagega
feasible aa gaya ab kya karun
feasible hone ke baad kitna waqt
entries.en: Feasible means the survey passed. The installation team contacts you within 48 hours, and after the technical desk creates the connection your status becomes Activated and your Account ID appears under My Connections.
entries.ur: Feasible ka matlab hai survey pass ho gaya. Installation team 48 ghante ke andar aap se rabta karti hai, aur technical desk connection banane ke baad aap ka status Activated ho jata hai aur Account ID My Connections mein nazar aati hai.

entries.title: Connection activated
q: my connection is activated what now
connection chalu ho gaya account id kahan
activation ke baad kya hota hai
connection chalu hone ke baad bill kab banega
connection activate ho gaya hai ab mujhe kya karna hai
entries.en: Once activated, your connection has an Account ID under My Connections. The accounts desk then generates invoices for it, and you see them in My Bills with a due date 10 days after each invoice is created.
entries.ur: Activate hone ke baad aap ke connection ki Account ID My Connections mein aa jati hai. Phir accounts desk us ke invoices banati hai, jo My Bills mein nazar aate hain aur har invoice ki due date banne ke 10 din baad hoti hai.

entries.title: Place another order
q: can i place more than one order
mere paas pehle se connection hai naya lena hai
ek hi ghar mein do connections
do connections ek hi account par lene hain
kya main ek se zyada order kar sakta hun
entries.en: Yes. You can place as many orders as you need, one connection type or plan per order, and each order shows up in My Orders. For several lines of the same plan, set the number of lines in a single order.
entries.ur: Ji haan. Aap jitne chahein orders kar sakte hain, har order mein ek connection type ya plan, aur har order My Orders mein nazar aata hai. Ek hi plan ki kai lines ke liye ek hi order mein lines ki tadad likh dein.

entries.title: Shift my connection
q: how do i shift my connection
ghar badal liya connection kaise shift karun
entries.en: There is no self-service shifting. Please ask at a retail outlet or send a complaint (category: Account & profile or Other) with your Account ID and the new address, and the team will advise.
entries.ur: Khud se shift karne ka option nahi hai. Kisi retail outlet se poochein ya apni Account ID aur naya address likh kar complaint (category: Account & profile ya Other) bhejein, team rehnumai karegi.

entries.title: Close my connection
q: how do i close my connection
entries.en: Connections are closed by the technical desk (permanently inactive). Please ask at a retail outlet or send a complaint (category: Account & profile or Other) with your Account ID. Clear any open bills first.
entries.ur: Connection technical desk band karti hai (permanently inactive). Kisi retail outlet se poochein ya apni Account ID likh kar complaint (category: Account & profile ya Other) bhejein. Pehle baqi bills ada kar dein.

entries.title: My connections
q: mera connection active hai ya nahi
mera plan konsa chal raha hai
kya mera connection chal raha hai
mere connection ka status kya hai

entries.title: Connection status meaning
q: active aur inactive mein kya farq hai
connection ka status kya hota hai
connection band kyun hai status inactive
permanently inactive ka matlab kya hai
temporarily inactive aur permanently inactive ka farq
entries.en: Active means the line is working. Temporarily inactive means it is paused and can be switched back on. Permanently inactive means it is closed for good and is no longer billed. The technical desk sets these statuses.
entries.ur: Active ka matlab line chal rahi hai. Temporarily inactive ka matlab wakti taur par band hai aur dobara chalu ho sakti hai. Permanently inactive ka matlab hamesha ke liye band hai aur uska bill nahi banta. Yeh status technical desk set karti hai.

entries.title: Connection not working
entries.en: Sorry about that. First restart your modem and check My Connections: if the status is Active, raise a complaint (category: Internet / connectivity) and a technician will be assigned. If the status is inactive, ask the outlet or raise a complaint.
entries.ur: Maazrat. Pehle apna modem restart karein aur My Connections mein status dekhein: agar Active ho to complaint (category: Internet / connectivity) bhejein, technician assign ho jayega. Agar inactive ho to outlet se poochein ya complaint bhejein.

entries.title: Slow internet
q: video nahi chal rahi internet slow
entries.en: Sorry about that. Restart your modem and test with one device. If it stays slow, raise a complaint (category: Internet / connectivity) with your Account ID so a technician can check the line.
entries.ur: Maazrat. Modem restart karein aur ek hi device se test karein. Agar phir bhi slow ho to apni Account ID likh kar complaint (category: Internet / connectivity) bhejein taake technician line check kare.

entries.title: Landline problem
q: landline par call nahi lag rahi
landline mein noise aa raha hai
ghar ka phone nahi chal raha
entries.en: Sorry about that. Check the handset and cable, then raise a complaint (category: Landline / call quality) with your Account ID so a technician can look at the line.
entries.ur: Maazrat. Handset aur cable check karein, phir apni Account ID likh kar complaint (category: Landline / call quality) bhejein taake technician line dekhe.

entries.title: Modem / equipment problem
q: modem ki lights nahi jal rahi
entries.en: Try switching the modem off for a minute and on again. If the problem remains, raise a complaint (category: Installation / equipment) so the technical desk can check or replace it.
entries.ur: Modem ko ek minute ke liye band karke dobara chalu karein. Agar masla rahe to complaint (category: Installation / equipment) bhejein taake technical desk check ya replace kare.

entries.title: Reactivate my connection
q: how do i reactivate my connection
temporarily inactive connection dobara chalu karna hai
inactive line wapas chalu karwani hai
entries.en: The technical desk switches a connection back to Active. Please clear any open bills first, then ask at a retail outlet or raise a complaint (category: Account & profile) with your Account ID.
entries.ur: Connection ko dobara Active technical desk karti hai. Pehle baqi bills ada kar dein, phir kisi retail outlet se poochein ya apni Account ID likh kar complaint (category: Account & profile) bhejein.

entries.title: Public Track page
q: how to search by order id
bina login ke order check kar sakta hun
id se order search karna hai
order id daal kar status dekhna hai
entries.en: The Track page needs no login. Enter an 11-character Order ID or a 16-character Account ID. Names and phone numbers are masked for visitors. Staff who are signed in see more.
entries.ur: Track page ke liye login ki zaroorat nahi. 11 characters ki Order ID ya 16 characters ki Account ID likhein. Visitors ke liye naam aur phone number chupe hote hain, aur login kiye hue staff ko zyada tafseel nazar aati hai.

entries.title: Advanced search
q: naam se order search karna hai
order ko naam se dhoondna hai
name ya contact number se connection dhoondo
entries.en: On the Track page open the advanced search. You can search orders and connections by name, contact number, connection type or application date range.
entries.ur: Track page par advanced search kholein. Aap naam, contact number, connection type ya application ki tareekh ke hisab se orders aur connections search kar sakte hain.

entries.title: Cities covered
q: aap ki service kahan kahan hai
kaun kaun se ilaqe cover hain

q: is service available in my city
kya mere ilaqe mein connection milega
service available hai meri jagah par
kya hamare area mein broadband hai

hamare mohalle mein service milti hai

entries.title: Apply at an outlet
q: can i apply at a shop
outlet par ja kar connection le sakta hun
online ya outlet kahan se behtar
bina internet ke apply kaise karun
kya outlet par bhi order hota hai
outlet par ja kar kya karna hota hai
entries.en: Yes. Visit any retail outlet with your name, phone number, address, city and ID proof. The outlet staff place the order for you and give you an Order ID to track.
entries.ur: Ji haan. Apna naam, phone number, address, shehar aur ID proof le kar kisi bhi retail outlet par jayein. Outlet staff aap ke liye order place kar ke Order ID de dete hain jis se aap track kar sakte hain.

entries.title: Order for someone else
q: can i order for someone else
kisi aur ke naam par connection
dost ke liye connection lena hai
kisi aur ke address par connection
mere bhai ke liye connection lagwana hai
entries.en: An order is placed against the customer who will hold the connection, with their own name, phone, address and ID proof. Ask them to register, or visit an outlet together.
entries.ur: Order us customer ke naam par hota hai jis ke paas connection rahega, us ke apne naam, phone, address aur ID proof ke saath. Unhein register karwa dein ya saath mein outlet par jayein.

entries.title: How to pay a bill
q: how do i pay my bill

public.en: You can pay at any retail outlet or at the accounts desk. After signing in, customers can also see their bills under My Bills and pay with the Pay now button, which is a demo payment.
public.ur: Aap kisi bhi retail outlet ya accounts desk par payment kar sakte hain. Login karne ke baad customer My Bills mein apne bills dekh kar Pay now button se bhi payment kar sakte hain, jo ek demo payment hai.

customer.en: Open My Bills and press Pay now on an unpaid bill, then choose Card, JazzCash or Easypaisa. It is a demo payment, so no real money is charged. You can also pay at any retail outlet or the accounts office.
customer.ur: My Bills kholein aur unpaid bill par Pay now dabayein, phir Card, JazzCash ya Easypaisa chunein. Yeh demo payment hai, is liye asli paise nahi kat te. Aap kisi bhi retail outlet ya accounts office par bhi payment kar sakte hain.

retail.en: Customers pay at your counter. Open the Collections tab, press collect on the open invoice, enter the amount and method (cash, card, UPI or cheque) and save. The receipt is recorded under your name.
retail.ur: Customer aap ke counter par payment karte hain. Collections tab kholein, open invoice par collect dabayein, raqam aur tareeqa (cash, card, UPI ya cheque) likhein aur save karein. Receipt aap ke naam par record hoti hai.

accounts.en: Open the Invoice Ledger, press Collect at office on the invoice, enter the amount and method (cash, card, UPI, cheque or online) and save. The payment appears under Receipts and the invoice becomes Paid or Partial.
accounts.ur: Invoice Ledger kholein, invoice par Collect at office dabayein, raqam aur tareeqa (cash, card, UPI, cheque ya online) likhein aur save karein. Payment Receipts mein nazar aati hai aur invoice Paid ya Partial ho jata hai.

entries.en: Customers pay at a retail outlet, at the accounts desk, or with Pay now in My Bills.
entries.ur: Customer retail outlet par, accounts desk par, ya My Bills ke Pay now se payment karte hain.

entries.title: How does Pay now work
q: pay now kaise kaam karta hai
pay now ka button kahan hai
pay now par click karne ke baad kya hota hai
entries.en: Sign in, open My Bills and press Pay now on an unpaid bill. Choose Card, JazzCash or Easypaisa, fill the form and confirm. After a few seconds of processing you see Success with a transaction ID and a View receipt link, or a Failure with the reason and Try again. This is a demo, so no real money is taken.
entries.ur: Login karein, My Bills kholein aur unpaid bill par Pay now dabayein. Card, JazzCash ya Easypaisa chunein, form bharein aur confirm karein. Chand second processing ke baad Success (transaction ID aur View receipt link ke saath) ya Failure (wajah aur Try again ke saath) nazar aata hai. Yeh demo hai, is liye asli paise nahi liye jate.

entries.title: Is online payment real?
q: kya card se asli paise katenge
demo payment ka matlab kya hai
kya meri card details save hoti hain
kya real money charge hota hai
entries.en: Pay now is a demo payment simulation: no real money is charged and no card number, expiry, CVV, wallet number or PIN is ever sent to the server or stored. Only the result, bill, method and amount are saved. Real payments are made at an outlet or the accounts office.
entries.ur: Pay now ek demo payment simulation hai: asli paise nahi kat te aur card number, expiry, CVV, wallet number ya PIN kabhi server ko nahi bheje jate aur na save hote hain. Sirf nateeja, bill, tareeqa aur raqam save hoti hai. Asli payment outlet ya accounts office par hoti hai.

entries.title: Demo test numbers
q: which card number should i use
demo mein kaun sa card chalega
payment fail karne ke liye number
jazzcash number kya daalun demo mein
entries.en: For the demo: any 16-digit card number succeeds, for example 4242 4242 4242 4242, and a number ending in 0002 fails. For JazzCash or Easypaisa any 03XX XXXXXXX number succeeds and a number ending in 0000 fails. Use any future expiry (MM/YY), a 3-digit CVV and a 4-digit PIN.
entries.ur: Demo ke liye: koi bhi 16 digit card number kamyab hoga, jaise 4242 4242 4242 4242, aur jo number 0002 par khatam ho woh fail hoga. JazzCash ya Easypaisa mein koi bhi 03XX XXXXXXX number kamyab hoga aur jo 0000 par khatam ho woh fail hoga. Aane wali koi bhi expiry (MM/YY), 3 digit CVV aur 4 digit PIN likh dein.

entries.title: Payment failed
q: payment ka error aa raha hai
paise kat gaye lekin payment nahi hui
pay now par failure aa gaya
entries.en: A failed payment never changes your bill and no money is taken. The failure message shows the reason, and you can press Try again. In the demo, card numbers ending in 0002 and wallet numbers ending in 0000 are made to fail on purpose. Still stuck? Raise a complaint (category: Billing & payments).
entries.ur: Fail hui payment se aap ka bill nahi badalta aur koi paisa nahi katta. Failure message mein wajah likhi hoti hai aur aap Try again dabasakte hain. Demo mein 0002 par khatam hone wale card aur 0000 par khatam hone wale wallet number jaan boojh kar fail kiye jate hain. Phir bhi masla ho to complaint (category: Billing & payments) bhejein.

entries.title: After a successful payment
q: my payment was successful what now
payment success ke baad receipt kahan
payment ke baad bill paid kab hoga
payment hone ke baad kya hota hai
receipt kahan se milegi payment ke baad
entries.en: On success the bill becomes Paid (or Partial), you get a transaction ID with a View receipt link, a Payment successful notification in the bell, and the accounts desk sees it under Receipts as Online (demo).
entries.ur: Kamyab payment par bill Paid (ya Partial) ho jata hai, aap ko transaction ID aur View receipt link milta hai, bell mein Payment successful notification aati hai, aur accounts desk ko woh Receipts mein Online (demo) ke taur par nazar aati hai.

entries.title: Paid but still showing due
q: i paid but the bill still shows due
maine payment kar di lekin due dikha raha hai
pay kar diya phir bhi bill baqi
payment hone ke baad bhi due amount
paise de diye lekin bill unpaid hai
receipt hai lekin bill paid nahi
entries.en: Refresh My Bills first. A bill shows Partial when only part of it was paid, and the rest stays due. If you paid at an outlet and it is missing, raise a complaint (category: Billing & payments) with the receipt number or payment reference.
entries.ur: Pehle My Bills refresh karein. Agar bill ka sirf kuch hissa ada hua ho to woh Partial dikhata hai aur baqi raqam due rehti hai. Agar outlet par payment ki thi aur woh nazar nahi aa rahi to receipt number ya payment reference likh kar complaint (category: Billing & payments) bhejein.

entries.title: Pay a paid bill again
q: can i pay a paid bill again
ek hi bill do dafa pay kar diya
entries.en: A bill that is already Paid cannot be paid again online, and a second click while a payment is being processed is rejected. If you paid twice at counters, raise a complaint (category: Billing & payments) with both receipts.
entries.ur: Jo bill pehle se Paid ho usay online dobara pay nahi kar sakte, aur payment process hote waqt doosra click reject ho jata hai. Agar counters par do dafa payment ho gayi ho to dono receipts ke saath complaint (category: Billing & payments) bhejein.

entries.title: Pay part of a bill
q: can i pay part of the bill
bill ka kuch hissa ada karna hai
qist mein bill de sakta hun
pura bill ek saath dena zaroori hai
entries.en: At a retail outlet or the accounts office staff can record a part payment, and the invoice shows Partial with the rest still due. Online Pay now always pays the full remaining balance.
entries.ur: Retail outlet ya accounts office par staff aadhi payment record kar sakta hai, aur invoice Partial dikhata hai jab ke baqi raqam due rehti hai. Online Pay now hamesha poora baqi balance ada karta hai.

entries.title: Payment methods
q: which payment methods do you accept
card se payment ho sakti hai
kaun kaun se tareeqon se payment
payment ke tareeqe kaun se hain
entries.en: At outlets and the accounts office you can pay by cash, card, UPI or cheque. Online, Pay now supports Card, JazzCash and Easypaisa as a demo payment.
entries.ur: Outlets aur accounts office par aap cash, card, UPI ya cheque se payment kar sakte hain. Online Pay now demo payment ke taur par Card, JazzCash aur Easypaisa support karta hai.

entries.title: Pay at an outlet
q: can i pay at the outlet
outlet par bill jama karwa sakta hun
dukan par payment ho sakti hai
retail shop se bill bhar sakta hun
kisi bhi outlet par bill jama
entries.en: Yes. Any retail outlet can take your payment and record it against your invoice. Bring your Account ID or invoice number.
entries.ur: Ji haan. Koi bhi retail outlet aap ki payment le kar invoice ke saath record kar sakta hai. Apni Account ID ya invoice number saath le jayein.

entries.title: Where are my receipts
q: where can i see my receipts

customer.en: Open My Bills to see each invoice with its payment history. For an online payment use the View receipt link, which opens a receipt page you can print or save as PDF.
customer.ur: My Bills kholein, wahan har invoice ke saath uski payment history nazar aati hai. Online payment ke liye View receipt link use karein, jo receipt page kholta hai jise print ya PDF ke taur par save kar sakte hain.

accounts.en: Open the Receipts tab to see every payment with its method, channel and reference. Online payments have a clickable reference that opens the receipt.
accounts.ur: Receipts tab kholein, wahan har payment uske tareeqe, channel aur reference ke saath nazar aati hai. Online payments ka reference click karne par receipt khulti hai.

admin.en: Open Billing & Payments to see all payments, or ask me for receipts to see the latest ones.
admin.ur: Billing & Payments kholein to saari payments nazar aati hain, ya mujh se receipts poochein to taaza receipts dikha dunga.

retail.en: Open the Collections tab to see the payments you took at the counter.
retail.ur: Collections tab mein woh payments nazar aati hain jo aap ne counter par li hon.

entries.en: Receipts are shown to signed-in customers, accounts staff and the outlet that took the payment.
entries.ur: Receipts login kiye hue customer, accounts staff aur wohi outlet dekh sakta hai jis ne payment li.

entries.title: Print or save a receipt
q: how do i print my receipt
entries.en: Open the receipt from the View receipt link (for online payments) and press Print, or choose Save as PDF in the browser's print window. A customer can open only their own receipts.
entries.ur: View receipt link (online payments ke liye) se receipt kholein aur Print dabayein, ya browser ki print window mein Save as PDF chunein. Customer sirf apni receipts khol sakta hai.

entries.title: View or print an invoice
q: how do i view my invoice
entries.en: Open the invoice from your bills list (View invoice) to get a printable page, then print it or save it as PDF from the browser. A customer can open only their own invoices.
entries.ur: Bills ki list se invoice kholein (View invoice), phir printable page ko browser se print karein ya PDF ke taur par save karein. Customer sirf apne invoices khol sakta hai.

entries.title: Bill due date
q: bill ki due date kya hai
bill kitne din mein bharna hota hai
entries.en: Every invoice is due 10 days after it is generated. The due date is shown on each bill in My Bills, and overdue bills are marked as overdue.
entries.ur: Har invoice ki due date banne ke 10 din baad hoti hai. Due date My Bills mein har bill par likhi hoti hai, aur guzri hui due date wale bills overdue dikhaye jate hain.

entries.title: Bill reminders
q: will i get a bill reminder
due date se pehle yaad dehani
bill payment ki yaad dehani kaise aati hai
entries.en: A reminder banner appears at the top of your portal and an alert in the notification bell when an unpaid bill is overdue or due within 5 days. Each stage is notified once, and the reminders clear when the bill is fully paid.
entries.ur: Jab koi unpaid bill overdue ho ya 5 din ke andar due ho to portal ke upar reminder banner aur notification bell mein alert aata hai. Har marhale par sirf ek dafa alert aata hai, aur bill poora ada hone par reminders khud khatam ho jate hain.

entries.title: How a bill is calculated
q: bill ka hisab kaise hota hai
bill mein kya kya shamil hai
entries.en: Bill = rental (the plan price) + usage - discount, then 12.24% service tax is added on that amount. The invoice page shows each part and the due amount.
entries.ur: Bill = rental (plan ki qeemat) + usage - discount, phir us raqam par 12.24% service tax lagta hai. Invoice page par har hissa aur due raqam likhi hoti hai.

entries.title: Why is my bill high
q: why is my bill so high
mera bill pehle se zyada kyun
entries.en: Open the invoice to see rental, usage, discount and 12.24% tax separately. A higher bill usually comes from added usage, a new plan rental or tax. If it still looks wrong, raise a complaint (category: Billing & payments) with the invoice number.
entries.ur: Invoice kholein, wahan rental, usage, discount aur 12.24% tax alag alag likhe hote hain. Bill zyada hone ki wajah aksar usage, naye plan ka rental ya tax hota hai. Phir bhi galat lage to invoice number likh kar complaint (category: Billing & payments) bhejein.

entries.title: I have not received a bill
q: i have not received my bill
meri bills ki list khali hai
entries.en: Invoices are generated by the accounts desk for each billing period, so a new connection may have none yet. Check My Bills, and if you expect one and it is missing, raise a complaint (category: Billing & payments).
entries.ur: Invoices accounts desk har billing period ke liye banati hai, is liye naye connection ka abhi koi bill na ho sakta hai. My Bills dekhein, aur agar bill hona chahiye tha lekin nahi hai to complaint (category: Billing & payments) bhejein.

entries.title: Overdue bill
q: my bill is overdue what should i do
due date nikal gayi ab kya karun
connection kat jayega agar bill na diya
bill nahi diya to kya hoga
bill pending hai connection band hoga
overdue bill ka kya karna chahiye
bill ki due date nikal gayi ab kya karun
entries.en: Pay it as soon as you can: with Pay now in My Bills, at an outlet or at the accounts office. There is no automatic late fee, but a connection's status is controlled by the technical desk, so do not leave bills unpaid for long.
entries.ur: Jitni jaldi ho sake ada kar dein: My Bills ke Pay now se, outlet par ya accounts office par. Khud ba khud late fee nahi lagti, lekin connection ka status technical desk control karti hai, is liye bills ko zyada der na rakhein.

invoice kis tareekh ko banta hai
kitne mahine ka bill aata hai
entries.en: The accounts desk generates an invoice for a connection and a billing period (for example a month). The rental defaults to the plan price, and the invoice is due 10 days after it is created.
entries.ur: Accounts desk kisi connection aur billing period (jaise ek mahina) ke liye invoice banati hai. Rental by default plan ki qeemat hota hai, aur invoice banne ke 10 din baad due hota hai.

sab se zyada baqaya kis ka hai
