entries.title: Add usage or discount to an invoice
q: how do i add usage to an invoice
invoice mein usage kaise add karun
bill mein extra charges add karne hain
rental change karna hai invoice mein
invoice mein tax kaise lagta hai
entries.en: In Generate Invoice choose the connection and billing period. The rental defaults to the plan price. Type any usage amount and any discount, and the form shows the 12.24% tax and the total before you issue it.
entries.ur: Generate Invoice mein connection aur billing period chunein. Rental by default plan ki qeemat hota hai. Usage aur discount ki raqam likh dein, to form issue karne se pehle 12.24% tax aur total dikha deta hai.

entries.title: Bill a closed connection
q: why can't i generate an invoice for a connection
permanently inactive connection ka bill kyun nahi ban raha
connection ka bill nahi ban sakta
connection list mein nahi aa raha invoice ke liye
bill banane ka option nahi aa raha
entries.en: A permanently inactive connection cannot be billed, so it is not offered in Generate Invoice. Temporarily inactive and active connections can be billed. If a connection was closed by mistake, the technical desk can set it back to Active.
entries.ur: Permanently inactive connection ka bill nahi ban sakta, is liye woh Generate Invoice mein nahi aata. Temporarily inactive aur active connections ka bill ban sakta hai. Agar connection ghalti se band hua ho to technical desk usay wapas Active kar sakti hai.

entries.title: Invoice ledger

accounts.en: The Invoice Ledger lists every invoice, paid and pending, with search, sort and paging. From a row you can open the printable invoice or collect payment at the office.
accounts.ur: Invoice Ledger mein har invoice, paid aur pending, search, sort aur paging ke saath nazar aata hai. Kisi row se printable invoice khol sakte hain ya office par payment collect kar sakte hain.

admin.en: The invoice ledger belongs to the accounts desk. As admin you can review every invoice and payment under Billing & Payments.
admin.ur: Invoice ledger accounts desk ka hissa hai. Admin ke taur par aap Billing & Payments mein har invoice aur payment dekh sakte hain.

entries.en: The Invoice Ledger lists every invoice.
entries.ur: Invoice Ledger mein har invoice nazar aata hai.

entries.title: Record a payment at the office
q: how do i record a payment
customer ne cash diya record kaise karun
entries.en: In the Invoice Ledger press Collect at office on the invoice, choose the method (cash, card, UPI, cheque or online), enter the amount and a reference if there is one, and save. The invoice becomes Paid or Partial and the payment appears under Receipts.
entries.ur: Invoice Ledger mein invoice par Collect at office dabayein, tareeqa (cash, card, UPI, cheque ya online) chunein, raqam aur agar reference ho to likhein aur save karein. Invoice Paid ya Partial ho jata hai aur payment Receipts mein nazar aati hai.

entries.title: Online payments for staff
q: online payment ka channel kya hai
online demo payments receipts mein kahan
customer ne online pay kiya mujhe kaise pata chalega
entries.en: When a customer pays with Pay now, the bill updates by itself and the payment appears in Receipts with the channel Online (demo). The Overview shows the online total, and accounts and admin staff get an Online payment received alert.
entries.ur: Jab customer Pay now se payment karta hai to bill khud update ho jata hai aur payment Receipts mein channel Online (demo) ke saath nazar aati hai. Overview mein online total dikhta hai, aur accounts aur admin staff ko Online payment received alert milta hai.

entries.title: Change the tax rate
q: can i change the tax rate
tax ka rate kahan set hota hai
entries.en: The service tax rate (12.24%) is fixed in the system and is not editable from a panel. A developer can change it in the code. To give a customer relief use the discount field when generating the invoice.
entries.ur: Service tax ka rate (12.24%) system mein fixed hai aur kisi panel se edit nahi hota. Developer ise code mein badal sakta hai. Customer ko riayat dene ke liye invoice banate waqt discount ka field use karein.

entries.title: Collections at my outlet
q: kitna paisa jama hua counter par

entries.title: Collect a payment at the counter
q: how do i collect a payment at the counter
customer bill dene aya hai kya karun
entries.en: Open the Collections tab. Open invoices of your outlet's connections are listed. Press collect on the invoice, enter the amount, choose the method (cash, card, UPI or cheque) and save. The receipt is recorded as taken by you at the counter.
entries.ur: Collections tab kholein. Aap ke outlet ke connections ke open invoices wahan hote hain. Invoice par collect dabayein, raqam likhein, tareeqa (cash, card, UPI ya cheque) chunein aur save karein. Receipt aap ke naam par counter payment ke taur par record hoti hai.

entries.title: Raise a complaint
q: how do i raise a complaint

customer.en: Open the Complaints tab in your portal, choose a category, write a subject and description, optionally attach a photo, and submit. You get a ticket number like TK-000001 and can follow every reply there.
customer.ur: Apne portal ke Complaints tab mein jayein, category chunein, subject aur description likhein, chahein to photo lagayein aur submit karein. Aap ko TK-000001 jaisa ticket number milta hai aur har reply wahin nazar aata hai.

public.en: To send a complaint or question, use the Contact us form. Signed-in customers can raise a tracked complaint from the Complaints tab of their portal.
public.ur: Complaint ya sawal bhejne ke liye Contact us form use karein. Login kiye hue customer apne portal ke Complaints tab se tracked complaint bhej sakte hain.

retail.en: Complaints are raised by customers in their portal. If a customer complains at your outlet, ask them to raise it from the Complaints tab, or contact the admin.
retail.ur: Complaints customer apne portal se bhejte hain. Agar customer aap ke outlet par complaint kare to unhein Complaints tab se bhejne ko kahein, ya admin se rabta karein.

technical.en: Complaints are raised by customers. The ones assigned to you appear in your My Tickets tab.
technical.ur: Complaints customers bhejte hain. Jo aap ko assign hon woh aap ke My Tickets tab mein nazar aati hain.

admin.en: Complaints are raised by customers. You see all of them in the Complaints tab and assign each to a technical employee.
admin.ur: Complaints customers bhejte hain. Aap un sab ko Complaints tab mein dekhte hain aur har ek technical employee ko assign karte hain.

entries.en: Customers raise complaints from the Complaints tab of their portal.
entries.ur: Customer apne portal ke Complaints tab se complaint bhejte hain.

entries.title: Complaint categories
q: complaint ki categories kaun si hain
entries.en: The categories are: Internet / connectivity, Landline / call quality, Billing & payments, Installation / equipment, Account & profile, and Other. Choose the closest one so the right team can help.
entries.ur: Categories yeh hain: Internet / connectivity, Landline / call quality, Billing & payments, Installation / equipment, Account & profile, aur Other. Sab se qareeb wali category chunein taake sahi team madad kar sake.

entries.title: Follow my complaint
q: how do i check my complaint
ticket ka status check karna hai
meri shikayat par kya karwai hui
meri complaint ka status kya hai

customer.en: Open the Complaints tab in your portal. Each ticket shows its status steps and every reply. You also get a bell notification whenever it is assigned, updated or replied to.
customer.ur: Apne portal ke Complaints tab mein jayein. Har ticket ke status steps aur saare replies nazar aate hain. Jab bhi ticket assign, update ya reply ho, bell mein notification bhi aati hai.

admin.en: Open the Complaints tab to see all tickets with status chips, filters and search.
admin.ur: Complaints tab mein tamam tickets status chips, filters aur search ke saath nazar aate hain.

technical.en: Open the My Tickets tab to see the complaints assigned to you and their status.
technical.ur: My Tickets tab mein aap ko assign ki gayi complaints aur unka status nazar aata hai.

entries.en: Signed-in customers follow their complaints in the portal.
entries.ur: Login kiye hue customer apni complaints portal mein dekhte hain.

entries.title: What do complaint statuses mean
q: what do the complaint statuses mean
complaint ka status kya matlab hai
open assigned in progress resolved closed
meri complaint kis stage par hai
resolved aur closed mein kya farq hai
entries.en: A complaint moves Open, then Assigned (admin picks a technical employee), then In progress (the technician starts work), then Resolved (the technician adds a fix note), then Closed (you confirm, or admin closes it). If it is not fixed you can reopen it.
entries.ur: Complaint is tarteeb se chalti hai: Open, phir Assigned (admin technical employee chunta hai), phir In progress (technician kaam shuru karta hai), phir Resolved (technician fix ka note likhta hai), aur aakhir mein Closed (aap tasdeeq karte hain ya admin band karta hai). Agar masla hal na ho to aap usay reopen kar sakte hain.

entries.title: Reply on a complaint
q: how do i reply on my complaint
aur details bhejni hain complaint mein
meri complaint mein kuch add karna hai
entries.en: Open the ticket and write your reply at the bottom, with a photo if needed. A reply after a ticket was Resolved moves it back to In progress, and the other side is notified.
entries.ur: Ticket kholein aur neeche apna reply likhein, zaroorat ho to photo ke saath. Resolved ke baad reply likhne par ticket wapas In progress ho jata hai, aur doosri taraf ko notification milti hai.

entries.title: Close or reopen a complaint
q: how do i close my complaint
masla hal ho gaya ticket band karna hai
masla hal nahi hua dobara kholna hai

customer.en: When a ticket is Resolved press Problem solved - close if it is fixed, or Not fixed - reopen if it is not. You can also withdraw a ticket that is still Open.
customer.ur: Jab ticket Resolved ho to masla hal ho gaya ho to Problem solved - close dabayein, warna Not fixed - reopen dabayein. Jo ticket abhi Open ho usay aap withdraw bhi kar sakte hain.

admin.en: Admin can close or reopen any ticket from the Complaints tab, and re-assign it while it is not yet Resolved or Closed.
admin.ur: Admin Complaints tab se kisi bhi ticket ko close ya reopen kar sakta hai, aur jab tak woh Resolved ya Closed na ho usay dobara assign bhi kar sakta hai.

entries.en: A customer closes or reopens a resolved ticket from the Complaints tab.
entries.ur: Customer resolved ticket ko Complaints tab se close ya reopen karta hai.

entries.title: Attach a photo
q: can i attach a photo to my complaint
photo kitni badi ho sakti hai
kaun si image format chalti hai
entries.en: Yes. You can attach one photo (JPG, PNG, WEBP or GIF, up to 3 MB) when you raise a complaint or when you reply.
entries.ur: Ji haan. Complaint bhejte waqt ya reply karte waqt aap ek photo (JPG, PNG, WEBP ya GIF, 3 MB tak) laga sakte hain.

entries.title: Complaint limit
q: how many complaints can i raise
complaint bhejne par error aa raha hai
entries.en: One customer can raise up to 5 complaints per hour. If you hit the limit, wait a while and add details to your existing ticket as a reply instead.
entries.ur: Ek customer ek ghante mein zyada se zyada 5 complaints bhej sakta hai. Limit poori ho jaye to thori der intezar karein aur apne maujooda ticket mein reply ke taur par tafseel likh dein.

entries.title: When will my complaint be answered
q: how long will my complaint take
ticket resolve hone mein kitna waqt lagta hai
kitne din mein masla hal hoga
technician kab aayega complaint ke baad
complaint par kab tak karwai hogi
deri kyun ho rahi hai complaint mein
entries.en: I can't promise a fixed time. After you raise a complaint the admin assigns it to a technician, and you get a notification at every step. If it stays Open for long, add a reply to your ticket or ask at an outlet.
entries.ur: Main koi tay shuda waqt nahi bata sakta. Complaint bhejne ke baad admin usay technician ko assign karta hai, aur har marhale par aap ko notification milti hai. Agar bohat der Open rahe to ticket mein reply likh dein ya outlet se poochein.

entries.title: Contact us form
entries.en: Use the Contact us option below to send a message. Visitors can also use the contact form on the Contact page or the feedback form on the home page. The network desk reads every message.
entries.ur: Message bhejne ke liye neeche Contact us option use karein. Visitors Contact page ka form ya home page ka feedback form bhi use kar sakte hain. Network desk har message parhti hai.

entries.title: Give feedback
q: service ki raye dena chahta hun
aap ki service kaisi hai review

entries.title: Where to leave feedback
q: kya main bina login feedback de sakta hun

public.en: Use the feedback form on the home page: pick a star rating, write your message and send. No login is needed.
public.ur: Home page ka feedback form use karein: star rating chunein, message likhein aur bhej dein. Login ki zaroorat nahi.

customer.en: Open the Feedback tab in your portal, choose a star rating, write your message and send.
customer.ur: Apne portal ke Feedback tab mein jayein, star rating chunein, message likhein aur bhej dein.

admin.en: Customer feedback arrives in the Feedback panel with the average rating. Ask me for feedback to see the latest messages.
admin.ur: Customer feedback Feedback panel mein average rating ke saath aata hai. Taaza messages dekhne ke liye mujh se feedback poochein.

entries.en: Customers and visitors can leave feedback from the portal or the home page.
entries.ur: Customers aur visitors portal ya home page se feedback de sakte hain.

entries.title: Manage complaints
q: complaint technician ko assign kaise karun
entries.en: Open the Complaints tab. Filter by status or search, open a ticket, and assign it to an active technical-desk employee who has a login (you can re-assign until it is Resolved or Closed). You can also reply, close or reopen it. Every step is logged in the Activity Log.
entries.ur: Complaints tab kholein. Status ya search se filter karein, ticket kholein aur usay technical desk ke aise active employee ko assign karein jis ka login bana ho (Resolved ya Closed hone tak dobara assign kar sakte hain). Aap reply, close ya reopen bhi kar sakte hain. Har qadam Activity Log mein likha jata hai.

entries.title: Work on assigned tickets
q: mujhe jo complaints assign hui hain wo kahan hain
ticket par kaam shuru kaise karun
ticket ka reply kaise dun technician
entries.en: Open the My Tickets tab. Press Start working on an assigned ticket, reply to the customer, and when the problem is fixed press Mark resolved with a fix note, which the customer can read. You only see tickets assigned to you.
entries.ur: My Tickets tab kholein. Assign hui ticket par Start working dabayein, customer ko reply likhein, aur masla hal hone par fix ke note ke saath Mark resolved dabayein, jo customer ko nazar aata hai. Aap ko sirf apni assign ki hui tickets nazar aati hain.

entries.title: Contact messages
q: visitors ke messages kahan aate hain
contact form ke messages dekhne hain
jo log contact us par likhte hain wo kahan hain
entries.en: Open the Messages tab to read what visitors send through the Contact us form. New messages also create a bell alert.
entries.ur: Messages tab mein woh paighamat nazar aate hain jo visitors Contact us form se bhejte hain. Naya message aane par bell mein alert bhi aata hai.

entries.title: Manage FAQs
q: how do i add a faq
entries.en: Open the FAQs tab and add, edit or delete a question and its answer. The changes appear on the public FAQ page.
entries.ur: FAQs tab kholein aur sawal aur jawab add, edit ya delete karein. Tabdeeliyan public FAQ page par nazar aati hain.

entries.title: Change my password
q: how do i change my password
entries.en: Open My account, then the Security tab (/account/security). Enter your current password and the new one. A strength bar and checklist guide you. The new password needs at least 6 characters and must not equal your username.
entries.ur: My account kholein, phir Security tab (/account/security). Apna purana password aur naya password likhein. Strength bar aur checklist aap ki rehnumai karte hain. Naya password kam az kam 6 characters ka ho aur username ke barabar na ho.

entries.title: Forgot my password
q: mera password yaad nahi aa raha
login nahi ho raha password galat
password reset link kahan se milega
entries.en: Open the Forgot password page and enter your username or email. A one-time reset link is created that works for 30 minutes. If email is not set up on the server, the link is shown on the screen instead. Then choose a new password.
entries.ur: Forgot password page kholein aur apna username ya email likhein. Ek baar chalne wala reset link banta hai jo 30 minute tak chalta hai. Agar server par email set na ho to link screen par dikha diya jata hai. Phir naya password chunein.

entries.title: Reset link not working
q: my reset link does not work
password reset link nahi chal raha
reset password link kaam nahi kar raha
link ek dafa hi chalta hai
entries.en: A reset link works only once and for 30 minutes, and asking for a new one cancels the old one. Request a fresh link from Forgot password. You can request up to 5 per 15 minutes. If no email arrives, the server may be in demo mode and shows the link on the screen.
entries.ur: Reset link sirf ek dafa aur 30 minute tak chalta hai, aur naya link maangne par purana band ho jata hai. Forgot password se naya link mangwa lein. 15 minute mein zyada se zyada 5 requests ho sakti hain. Agar email na aaye to ho sakta hai server demo mode mein ho aur link screen par dikhata ho.

entries.title: Password rules
q: password kitne characters ka hona chahiye
password username jaisa rakh sakta hun
entries.en: A password needs at least 6 characters (up to 100) and must not be the same as your username. The strength meter on the page shows how strong it is, so mix letters, numbers and symbols.
entries.ur: Password kam az kam 6 characters (zyada se zyada 100) ka ho aur username ke barabar na ho. Page par strength meter dikhata hai ke password kitna mazboot hai, is liye letters, numbers aur symbols milakar rakhein.

entries.title: Account locked after wrong passwords
q: kitni baar galat password daal sakta hun
5 minute baad try karein ka matlab
entries.en: After 5 wrong passwords the login is locked for about 5 minutes. Wait and try again, or use Forgot password: a successful reset also unlocks the login.
entries.ur: 5 galat passwords ke baad login takreeban 5 minute ke liye lock ho jata hai. Intezar karke dobara koshish karein, ya Forgot password use karein: kamyab reset se login unlock bhi ho jata hai.

entries.title: Forgot my username
entries.en: I can't show usernames. On the Forgot password page you can type your email address instead of the username. Otherwise ask the outlet where you registered, or your administrator.
entries.ur: Main username nahi dikha sakta. Forgot password page par username ki jagah apna email likh sakte hain. Warna jis outlet par register kiya wahan se ya apne administrator se poochein.

entries.title: Change my profile photo
q: how do i change my profile photo
profile image upload nahi ho rahi
photo kaise lagani hai profile mein
entries.en: Open My account (or the Profile tab in the customer portal). Under Profile photo upload a new picture or remove the current one.
entries.ur: My account (ya customer portal ka Profile tab) kholein. Profile photo ke neeche nayi tasveer upload karein ya maujooda hata dein.

entries.title: Update my contact details
q: how do i update my phone number
profile mein details theek karwani hain

customer.en: Your profile page shows your details, but they are changed by staff. Visit a retail outlet or send a complaint (category: Account & profile) with the correction.
customer.ur: Aap ke profile page par aap ki tafseelat nazar aati hain lekin unhein staff badalta hai. Kisi retail outlet par jayein ya correction likh kar complaint (category: Account & profile) bhejein.

retail.en: Open the Customers tab, find the customer and use the edit option to correct their contact details before placing an order.
retail.ur: Customers tab kholein, customer dhoondein aur edit ka option use karke order se pehle un ki contact details theek karein.

admin.en: Open the Customers tab, find the customer and use Edit to correct the details.
admin.ur: Customers tab kholein, customer dhoondein aur Edit se tafseelat theek karein.

entries.en: Contact details are corrected by staff. Please ask at a retail outlet.
entries.ur: Contact details staff theek karta hai. Kisi retail outlet se poochein.

entries.title: Sign out
entries.en: Use the Logout button in the sidebar (or the top bar on mobile). Always sign out on a shared computer.
entries.ur: Sidebar mein Logout button dabayein (mobile par upar wali bar mein). Shared computer par hamesha logout kar dein.

entries.title: OTP / two-factor login
entries.en: Login currently uses a username and password only, with a lock after 5 wrong attempts. There is no OTP or two-factor step, so choose a strong password and never share it.
entries.ur: Abhi login sirf username aur password se hota hai, aur 5 galat koshishon ke baad lock lag jata hai. OTP ya two-factor ka marhala nahi hai, is liye mazboot password rakhein aur kisi se share na karein.

entries.title: Passwords and system secrets
q: kisi ka password kaise pata karun
kisi aur ka account kaise khologa
kisi ka password reset kar do

entries.title: Account safety tips
q: how do i keep my account safe
koi mere account mein login kar raha hai
account hack hone se kaise bachun
entries.en: Use a strong password, change it from the Security page if you suspect someone knows it, never share it, and log out on shared computers. Staff can see who changed what in the Activity Log.
entries.ur: Mazboot password rakhein, shak ho to Security page se badal dein, kisi se share na karein, aur shared computer par logout kar dein. Staff Activity Log mein dekh sakta hai ke kis ne kya badla.

entries.title: Notifications bell
q: bell icon par kya aata hai
bell mein kya kya aata hai

customer.en: The bell shows alerts for your order status changes, new bills and bill-due reminders, payments, and complaint updates or replies. Press Mark all read to clear them.
customer.ur: Bell mein aap ke order status ki tabdeeli, naye bills aur bill-due reminders, payments, aur complaint ke updates ya replies ke alerts nazar aate hain. Mark all read dabane se saaf ho jate hain.

accounts.en: Your bell shows new bills, received payments (including online demo payments) and related alerts for the accounts desk.
accounts.ur: Aap ki bell mein naye bills, mausool hui payments (online demo payments samet) aur accounts desk ke mutaliq alerts nazar aate hain.

technical.en: Your bell shows new orders waiting for survey, complaints assigned to you, ticket replies and status changes.
technical.ur: Aap ki bell mein survey ke intezar mein naye orders, aap ko assign hui complaints, ticket replies aur status ki tabdeeliyan nazar aati hain.

retail.en: Your bell shows status changes of orders placed at your outlet and payment alerts.
retail.ur: Aap ki bell mein aap ke outlet ke orders ke status ki tabdeeliyan aur payment alerts nazar aate hain.

admin.en: Your bell shows new orders, payments, complaints, contact messages, feedback and ticket updates. Press Mark all read to clear them.
admin.ur: Aap ki bell mein naye orders, payments, complaints, contact messages, feedback aur ticket updates nazar aate hain. Mark all read dabane se saaf ho jate hain.

entries.en: The bell shows alerts for signed-in users, and each person sees only their own alerts.
entries.ur: Bell login kiye hue users ko alerts dikhati hai, aur har shakhs sirf apne alerts dekhta hai.

entries.title: Activity log
q: kis ne kya badla dekhna hai
entries.en: Open the Activity Log tab to see who changed what and when, with old and new values. Filter by user, action, date or text. It is read-only.
entries.ur: Activity Log tab mein dekha ja sakta hai ke kis ne kya aur kab badla, purani aur nayi values ke saath. User, action, tareekh ya text se filter karein. Yeh sirf parhne ke liye hai.

entries.title: Export to Excel / CSV / PDF

admin.en: Use the Export buttons above the tables to download Excel (.xlsx) or CSV, or open the print view and Save as PDF. You can export orders, customers, connections, bills, payments and dues.
admin.ur: Tables ke upar Export buttons se Excel (.xlsx) ya CSV download karein, ya print view kholkar Save as PDF karein. Aap orders, customers, connections, bills, payments aur dues export kar sakte hain.

accounts.en: Use the Export buttons above the tables to download Excel (.xlsx) or CSV, or open the print view and Save as PDF. You can export bills, payments and dues.
accounts.ur: Tables ke upar Export buttons se Excel (.xlsx) ya CSV download karein, ya print view kholkar Save as PDF karein. Aap bills, payments aur dues export kar sakte hain.

retail.en: Use the Export buttons above the tables to download Excel (.xlsx) or CSV, or open the print view and Save as PDF. You can export your own outlet's orders, customers, connections, bills and payments.
retail.ur: Tables ke upar Export buttons se Excel (.xlsx) ya CSV download karein, ya print view kholkar Save as PDF karein. Aap sirf apne outlet ke orders, customers, connections, bills aur payments export kar sakte hain.

entries.en: Export is available to admin, accounts and retail staff.
entries.ur: Export admin, accounts aur retail staff ke liye hai.

entries.title: Export for other roles
q: kya main data export kar sakta hun
data export ka option nahi mil raha
entries.en: Export to Excel, CSV and PDF is available to admin, accounts and retail staff. Customers can print their invoices and receipts from their own pages.
entries.ur: Excel, CSV aur PDF export admin, accounts aur retail staff ke liye hai. Customer apne invoices aur receipts apne pages se print kar sakte hain.

entries.title: Dashboard charts

admin.en: Open the Overview tab: monthly revenue (invoiced vs collected), orders by status and connections by plan, all drawn from your real records. Without internet the older SVG charts are shown.
admin.ur: Overview tab kholein: mahana revenue (invoiced vs collected), status ke hisab se orders aur plan ke hisab se connections, sab asli records se. Internet na ho to purane SVG charts nazar aate hain.

accounts.en: Open the Overview tab: collections vs dues for six months and a collected vs outstanding doughnut, drawn from real payments and unpaid invoices.
accounts.ur: Overview tab kholein: chhe mahine ke collections vs dues aur collected vs outstanding doughnut, asli payments aur unpaid invoices se.

entries.en: Charts are on the Overview tab of the admin and accounts desks.
entries.ur: Charts admin aur accounts desk ke Overview tab par hain.

entries.title: Quick search shortcut
q: is there a shortcut to search
slash press karne se kya hota hai
entries.en: Press Ctrl+K (or the / key) anywhere in a panel to open the command palette and jump quickly to a tab or page.
entries.ur: Kisi bhi panel mein Ctrl+K (ya / key) dabayein to command palette khulta hai jis se aap jaldi kisi tab ya page par ja sakte hain.

entries.title: Search, sort and paging
q: how do i search in a table
entries.en: Every table has a search box above it, clickable column headings to sort, and paging at the bottom. Type part of a name, ID or phone number to filter the rows.
entries.ur: Har table ke upar search box, sort ke liye column headings par click, aur neeche paging hoti hai. Rows filter karne ke liye naam, ID ya phone number ka kuch hissa likh dein.

entries.title: Access denied page
q: why do i see access denied
access denied kyun aa raha hai
mujhe page nahi khul raha ijazat nahi
mere role ko kyun nahi dikh raha
entries.en: Each login can open only the panels of its own role, so a page from another desk shows Access denied. Sign in with the right account, or ask your administrator.
entries.ur: Har login sirf apne role ke panels khol sakta hai, is liye doosri desk ka page Access denied dikhata hai. Sahi account se login karein ya apne administrator se poochein.

entries.title: Upload or change pictures
q: how do i upload an image
plan ya employee ki image change karni hai
entries.en: In Customers, Employees, Vendors, Equipment & Stock, Retail Shops and Plans & Charges, open a record's edit dialog and use the picture box to upload, change or remove its image.
entries.ur: Customers, Employees, Vendors, Equipment & Stock, Retail Shops aur Plans & Charges mein kisi record ka edit dialog kholein aur picture box se tasveer upload, change ya remove karein.

entries.title: Website is not loading properly
entries.en: The pages load some styles, icons and charts from the internet, so please check your connection and refresh the page (Ctrl+F5). If a page still fails, tell the administrator which page and what you saw.
entries.ur: Pages kuch styles, icons aur charts internet se load karte hain, is liye apna internet check karein aur page refresh karein (Ctrl+F5). Phir bhi masla ho to administrator ko batayein ke kaun sa page tha aur kya nazar aaya.

entries.title: Sign in to see your data
q: mera connection active hai ya nahi
mera plan konsa chal raha hai
kya mera connection chal raha hai
entries.en: Your own connections, orders, bills and profile are private, so please sign in first. Visitors can still see plans, charges and outlets, and track an order by its ID.
entries.ur: Aap ke apne connections, orders, bills aur profile private hain, is liye pehle login karein. Visitors plans, charges aur outlets dekh sakte hain aur ID se order track kar sakte hain.

entries.title: Place an order for a customer
q: how do i place an order for a customer
order kaise place karun customer ke liye
customer connection ke liye aya hai kya karun

entries.title: Add a new customer
q: how do i add a new customer
customer register karna hai outlet par
naye customer ki details kahan likhun

retail.en: Open the Customers tab and add the customer with name, phone, address and city (email, alternate phone and ID proof are optional). Or enter the new customer's details directly on the Place Order tab while placing the order.
retail.ur: Customers tab kholein aur customer ka naam, phone, address aur shehar likh kar add karein (email, alternate phone aur ID proof zaroori nahi). Ya order place karte waqt Place Order tab par hi naye customer ki tafseelat likh dein.

admin.en: Open the Customers tab and add or edit a customer with name, phone, address, city and optional ID proof. Customers can also register themselves.
admin.ur: Customers tab kholein aur naam, phone, address, shehar aur ID proof ke saath customer add ya edit karein. Customers khud bhi register kar sakte hain.

entries.en: Customers are added by retail staff or admin, or register themselves.
entries.ur: Customers retail staff ya admin add karte hain, ya khud register karte hain.

entries.title: Find a customer
q: how do i find a customer
customer ko naam se dhoondna hai
kisi customer ki details dekhni hain
entries.en: Open the Customers tab and type a name or phone number in the search box above the table. The rows filter as you type, and you can sort by any column.
entries.ur: Customers tab kholein aur table ke upar search box mein naam ya phone number likhein. Likhte hi rows filter hoti hain, aur kisi bhi column se sort kar sakte hain.

entries.title: Order remarks and invoices
q: can i add remarks to an order
order par invoice link kahan hai
order book mein invoice dekhna hai
entries.en: On the Place Order form you can write a remark that stays with the order. In the Order Book each order shows its status and, once billed, links to its invoices.
entries.ur: Place Order form mein aap remark likh sakte hain jo order ke saath rehta hai. Order Book mein har order ka status aur bill banne ke baad us ke invoices ke links nazar aate hain.

entries.title: Only my outlet's data
q: can i see other outlets orders
dusre outlet ke orders dekh sakta hun
kya main sab outlets ka data dekh sakta hun
sirf mere outlet ka data kyun dikhta hai
entries.en: No. A retail login sees only the orders, connections, invoices and collections of its own outlet. Admin sees every outlet.
entries.ur: Nahi. Retail login sirf apne outlet ke orders, connections, invoices aur collections dekhta hai. Admin har outlet dekh sakta hai.

entries.title: Feasibility queue
q: kitne orders ka survey baqi hai
feasibility ke liye kaun se orders hain

entries.title: Mark an order feasible or not
q: how do i mark an order feasible
order ko not feasible kaise karun
feasible ya infeasible kaise set karte hain
entries.en: Open the Feasibility Queue, review the pending order and mark it Feasible or Not feasible. Feasible orders move to the Provision Deck, and the customer and outlet are notified.
entries.ur: Feasibility Queue kholein, pending order dekhein aur usay Feasible ya Not feasible mark karein. Feasible orders Provision Deck mein chale jate hain, aur customer aur outlet ko notification milti hai.

entries.title: Provision a connection
q: how do i create a connection
feasible order ka connection banana hai
account id kaise generate hoti hai
entries.en: Open the Provision Deck, pick a feasible order and provision it. An account ID is generated, the order becomes Connected, and the equipment is taken from stock. A bulk order creates one account per line, so enough equipment must be in stock.
entries.ur: Provision Deck kholein, feasible order chunein aur provision karein. Account ID ban jati hai, order Connected ho jata hai, aur equipment stock se kam ho jata hai. Bulk order ki har line ka alag account banta hai, is liye stock mein kaafi equipment hona chahiye.

entries.title: Bulk orders and stock
q: bulk order ka connection kaise banega
stock kam hai provision nahi ho raha
equipment kam hai connection nahi ban raha
modem kam hain bulk order ke liye
bulk order mein har line ka account
entries.en: A bulk order creates one connection and one account ID per line and needs one set of equipment for each. If stock is short, provisioning stops with a message: receive stock in the Equipment Bay (or ask admin to order more) and provision again.
entries.ur: Bulk order mein har line ka alag connection aur account ID banta hai aur har line ke liye equipment ka ek set chahiye. Stock kam ho to provisioning message ke saath ruk jati hai: Equipment Bay mein stock receive karein (ya admin se mazeed mangwayein) aur dobara provision karein.

entries.title: Change connection status
q: how do i change a connection status
connection band kaise karte hain staff
status change karna hai connection ka
entries.en: Open the Connection Grid and change the connection's status to Active, Temporarily inactive or Permanently inactive. A permanently inactive connection is no longer billed. The customer sees the new status in My Connections.
entries.ur: Connection Grid kholein aur connection ka status Active, Temporarily inactive ya Permanently inactive kar dein. Permanently inactive connection ka bill nahi banta. Customer ko naya status My Connections mein nazar aata hai.

entries.title: Equipment stock
q: reorder level se neeche kya hai
kya stock khatam ho raha hai

entries.title: Add or receive equipment
q: delivery aayi hai stock update karna hai
stock ki ginti theek karni hai

technical.en: Open the Equipment Bay. Add a new product with its type (modem, router, telephone or cabling), vendor and opening stock, press + Receive on a row when a delivery arrives, or correct a count.
technical.ur: Equipment Bay kholein. Nayi product type (modem, router, telephone ya cabling), vendor aur opening stock ke saath add karein, delivery aane par row par + Receive dabayein, ya ginti theek karein.

admin.en: Open Equipment & Stock to add a product (type, vendor, reorder level, opening stock), or press Receive stock on a row when a delivery arrives. Procurement shows what to order.
admin.ur: Equipment & Stock kholein: product add karein (type, vendor, reorder level, opening stock), ya delivery aane par row par Receive stock dabayein. Procurement dikhata hai ke kya mangwana hai.

entries.en: Equipment is managed by the technical desk and admin.
entries.ur: Equipment technical desk aur admin sambhalte hain.

entries.title: Add an employee
q: how do i add an employee
entries.en: Open the Employees tab and add a new employee: name, department (Administration, Accounts, Technical or Retail outlet), designation, email, phone, a login username and a password of at least 6 characters. Retail employees are linked to a shop. The employee can then sign in to the matching panel.
entries.ur: Employees tab kholein aur naya employee add karein: naam, department (Administration, Accounts, Technical ya Retail outlet), designation, email, phone, login username aur kam az kam 6 characters ka password. Retail employees ek shop se jude hote hain. Phir employee apne panel mein login kar sakta hai.

entries.title: Vendors
q: kis vendor se modem aate hain

entries.title: Add a vendor
q: how do i add a vendor
entries.en: Open the Vendors tab and add a vendor: name, contact person, email, phone, address and the products supplied. Use Edit to change a vendor later. Equipment can then be linked to its vendor.
entries.ur: Vendors tab kholein aur vendor add karein: naam, contact person, email, phone, address aur jo products supply karta hai. Baad mein tabdeeli ke liye Edit use karein. Phir equipment ko us ke vendor se jora ja sakta hai.

entries.title: Manage retail shops
q: how do i add a retail shop
shop ka manager kaise set karun
entries.en: Open the Retail Shops tab and add an outlet with a code (for example NX-105), name, city, phone, address and an optional manager. Use Edit to change it later. Visitors see the outlets on the home page and in the Outlets list.
entries.ur: Retail Shops tab kholein aur outlet add karein: code (jaise NX-105), naam, shehar, phone, address aur chahein to manager. Baad mein Edit se badal sakte hain. Visitors outlets ko home page aur Outlets list mein dekhte hain.

entries.title: Manage plans and charges
q: how do i add a plan
entries.en: Open Plans & Charges. Add or edit a plan with connection type, category, name, speed, price, validity, deposit, call rates, description and active flag. An inactive plan is hidden from visitors and customers. You can also upload a plan picture.
entries.ur: Plans & Charges kholein. Connection type, category, naam, speed, qeemat, validity, deposit, call rates, description aur active flag ke saath plan add ya edit karein. Inactive plan visitors aur customers se chupa rehta hai. Plan ki tasveer bhi upload kar sakte hain.

entries.title: Why can't I assign a ticket
q: why can't i assign a ticket
assign ke liye employee nahi mil raha
complaint kis ko assign karun jab koi technician nahi
technician ka login kaise banaun ticket ke liye
entries.en: A ticket can only be assigned to an active employee of the Technical department who has a login. Add one in the Employees tab (department Technical, with a username and password), then assign again.
entries.ur: Ticket sirf Technical department ke aise active employee ko assign hota hai jis ka login bana ho. Employees tab mein aisa employee add karein (department Technical, username aur password ke saath) aur phir dobara assign karein.

entries.title: Accounts desk tabs
q: what can the accounts desk do
accounts panel mein kya kya hai
accounts ke kaam kaun se hain
invoice ledger dues receipts kahan hain
entries.en: The accounts desk has five tabs: Overview (collections and dues with charts), Generate Invoice, Invoice Ledger, Customer Dues and Receipts. Ask me for the billing summary, customer dues or receipts for live numbers.
entries.ur: Accounts desk ke paanch tabs hain: Overview (collections aur dues ke charts), Generate Invoice, Invoice Ledger, Customer Dues aur Receipts. Live raqam ke liye mujh se billing summary, customer dues ya receipts poochein.

entries.title: Technical desk tabs
q: what can the technical desk do
technical panel mein kya kya hai
entries.en: The technical desk has six tabs: Feasibility Queue, Provision Deck, Order Tracker, Connection Grid, Equipment Bay and My Tickets. Ask me for the feasibility queue, low stock or order tracker for live numbers.
entries.ur: Technical desk ke chhe tabs hain: Feasibility Queue, Provision Deck, Order Tracker, Connection Grid, Equipment Bay aur My Tickets. Live raqam ke liye mujh se feasibility queue, low stock ya order tracker poochein.

entries.title: Retail desk tabs
q: what can the retail desk do
retail panel mein kya kya hai
place order book collections kahan hain
entries.en: The retail desk has five tabs: Place Order, Order Book, Customers, Connections and Collections. All of them show only your own outlet's data.
entries.ur: Retail desk ke paanch tabs hain: Place Order, Order Book, Customers, Connections aur Collections. Sab mein sirf aap ke apne outlet ka data nazar aata hai.

entries.title: Customer portal tabs
q: what is in the customer portal
customer portal mein kya kya hai
meri portal par kya kar sakta hun
my account page par kya hai
overview orders connections bills complaints feedback profile
entries.en: The customer portal has seven tabs: Overview, My Orders, My Connections, My Bills, Complaints, Feedback and Profile. You can place orders, follow them, pay bills, raise complaints and manage your photo and password.
entries.ur: Customer portal ke saat tabs hain: Overview, My Orders, My Connections, My Bills, Complaints, Feedback aur Profile. Yahan se aap order place kar sakte hain, track kar sakte hain, bills ada kar sakte hain, complaints bhej sakte hain aur apni photo aur password sambhal sakte hain.

entries.title: Admin panels
q: admin panel mein kya kya hai
admin ke paas kaun se panels hain
kaun kaun se tabs hain admin mein
admin dashboard mein kya kya hai
entries.en: Admin has these tabs: Overview, Customers, Orders, Connections, Billing & Payments, Employees, Vendors, Equipment & Stock, Procurement, Retail Shops, Plans & Charges, Feedback, Complaints, Messages, FAQs and Activity Log.
entries.ur: Admin ke yeh tabs hain: Overview, Customers, Orders, Connections, Billing & Payments, Employees, Vendors, Equipment & Stock, Procurement, Retail Shops, Plans & Charges, Feedback, Complaints, Messages, FAQs aur Activity Log.

entries.title: Other desks' work
entries.en: That belongs to the staff desks and is not available for your login. I can help with plans, charges, outlets, orders, bills, complaints and tracking.
entries.ur: Yeh staff desks ka hissa hai aur aap ke login ke liye dastiyab nahi. Main plans, charges, outlets, orders, bills, complaints aur tracking mein madad kar sakta hoon.

entries.title: Picture size and format
q: photo kitni badi ho sakti hai upload ke liye
kaun si image format allow hai
photo upload ka error aa raha hai
entries.en: Pictures must be real JPG, PNG, WEBP or GIF files of up to 3 MB. The content is checked, so renaming another file type will not work.
entries.ur: Tasveer asli JPG, PNG, WEBP ya GIF file ho aur 3 MB tak ho. File ka content check hota hai, is liye kisi aur file ka naam badalne se kaam nahi chalega.

entries.title: How many lines per order
q: how many lines can i order at once
ek order mein kitni lines ho sakti hain
aik saath kitne connections order kar sakta hun
ek order mein zyada se zyada kitne connections
entries.en: One order can have from 1 up to 10,000 lines. From 10 lines the order counts as corporate and gets the bulk discount.
entries.ur: Ek order mein 1 se le kar 10,000 tak lines ho sakti hain. 10 lines se order corporate ho jata hai aur bulk discount milta hai.

entries.title: What is the reorder level
q: reorder level se neeche ka matlab
stock kab low maana jata hai
kam stock ka alert kab aata hai
entries.en: Every equipment item has a reorder level. When its stock is at or below that level it is listed as low stock, and Procurement suggests how much to order. Admin sets the level when adding or editing the item.
entries.ur: Har equipment item ka ek reorder level hota hai. Jab us ka stock us level par ya us se neeche ho to woh low stock mein aata hai aur Procurement batata hai ke kitna mangwana hai. Admin item add ya edit karte waqt yeh level set karta hai.

entries.title: How procurement suggestions work
q: kitna mangwana hai kaise pata chalta hai
entries.en: Procurement compares equipment stock with the demand from orders that still need provisioning, and with each item's reorder level. Items where stock is short are listed so you can order from the right vendor, then use Receive stock when the delivery arrives.
entries.ur: Procurement equipment ke stock ko un orders ki demand se milata hai jin ki provisioning baqi hai, aur har item ke reorder level se bhi. Jin items ka stock kam ho woh list ho jate hain taake aap sahi vendor se mangwa sakein, aur delivery aane par Receive stock karein.

entries.title: Connections of my outlet
q: where can i see my outlet's connections
mere outlet ke connections kahan hain
jo connections maine lagwaye wo kahan hain
connections tab kahan hai retail mein
entries.en: Open the Connections tab to see the connections created from your outlet's orders, with their plan and status. Only your own outlet's connections are shown.
entries.ur: Connections tab kholein, wahan aap ke outlet ke orders se bane connections un ke plan aur status ke saath nazar aate hain. Sirf aap ke apne outlet ke connections dikhaye jate hain.

entries.title: Does it work on a phone
q: phone se use kar sakta hun
mobile se bill pay kar sakta hun
entries.en: Yes. The website adapts to phones and tablets, and on a small screen the sidebar becomes a menu in the top bar. There is no separate mobile app.
entries.ur: Ji haan. Website phone aur tablet ke hisab se adjust ho jati hai, aur chhoti screen par sidebar upar ki bar mein menu ban jata hai. Alag se koi mobile app nahi hai.

entries.title: Employee departments
q: employee department kaun se hote hain
entries.en: Employees belong to one of four departments: Administration, Accounts, Technical or Retail outlet. Employees with a login open the panel of their department, and Retail employees are linked to a shop.
entries.ur: Employees chaar departments mein se kisi ek ke hote hain: Administration, Accounts, Technical ya Retail outlet. Login wale employees apne department ka panel kholte hain, aur Retail employees kisi shop se jude hote hain.

entries.title: Order vs connection
q: what is the difference between an order and a connection
order aur connection mein kya farq hai
order kya hai connection kya hai
order ke baad connection kab banta hai
connection kab milta hai order ke baad
entries.en: An order is your request for service. A connection is the working line created after the survey passes and the technical desk provisions it. One order can create several connections, one per line.
entries.ur: Order service ki aap ki darkhwast hai. Connection woh chalti hui line hai jo survey pass hone aur technical desk ke provision karne ke baad banti hai. Ek order se kai connections ban sakte hain, har line ka ek.

entries.title: Billing of many lines
q: how are bills for many lines made
kai connections ka bill kaise banta hai
har line ka alag bill aata hai
10 lines ka bill alag alag hoga
bulk order ka bill kaise banega
entries.en: Every connection has its own account ID, and invoices are generated per connection, so a bulk order produces one invoice per line for each billing period.
entries.ur: Har connection ki apni account ID hoti hai aur invoices har connection ke liye bante hain, is liye bulk order mein har billing period ki har line ka alag invoice banta hai.

entries.title: What D, B and T mean
q: what do the letters d b t mean
d b t ka matlab kya hai
id ke shuru mein b kyun hai
t se shuru hone wali id
d se shuru hone wali id kya hai
entries.en: The first letter of an Order ID or Account ID shows the connection type: D is Dial-Up, B is Broadband and T is Landline.
entries.ur: Order ID ya Account ID ka pehla letter connection type batata hai: D Dial-Up, B Broadband aur T Landline.
